messages:
support-alex: hey SREs — customer INC-9423 reporting lots of inference 5xx/timeouts from hosted API in us-west-2 over the last 30m. They see p50 fine, p99 spikes and failures on short requests. attaching example: 

support-alex: \`POST /v1/generate\` -> 504 after 10s, client retrying and hitting 429 after burst. customer says this started ~23:10 UTC. ticket: https://redwoodsupport.example/inc/9423 :warning:

sre-lucy: thanks Alex — grabbing alerts. do we have a recent deploy in that region? also any rate-limit changes?

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15_2315 by eng-raj to hosted-infer-us-west2 completed at 2398765200. config: batcher-v2 enabled, prefetch=on.

oncall-bot: SLO: inference-hosted-us-west2 latency.p99 breach (10m window) triggered at 2398765370. Pager severity: P2.

obs-jen: jumping in — dashboard: https://obs.redwood.example/d/hosted-infer/us-west2-latency. preliminary look: long tail tokens show spikes and increased queue time on the model pool. traces sparse — sampling dropped from 10%->1% after deploy? looks like trace coverage gap starting ~2398765150.

sre-lucy: can you paste the logs query you used? need to correlate 5xx and batching backlog.

obs-jen: sure — here's the LogQL I ran for gateway and runtime errors: 
```
{env="prod", region="us-west2"} |= "handler_error" or |= "timeout" | json | line_format "{ts} {service} {level} {msg} {request_id}" | sort_desc ts | limit 200
```
results: spike of handler_error with code 504 and runtime queue length metrics showing queue_depth ~ 85 per GPU (norm ~ 8).

eng-raj: rollback suggestion? the batcher-v2 change was intended to reduce GPU wastage but may increase head-of-line blocking for short requests. I can roll back batcher-v2 on the affected pool.

sre-lucy: please don't roll back immediately — want to avoid flapping. mitigation first: reduce max_batch_size and lower batch wait timeout to 30ms for us-west2 model pool and disable prefetch. can we do config tweak and scale up pool by 2 nodes?

eng-raj: ack — applying tentative config change to pool-id: pool-usw2-03. patch: 
```yaml
batcher:
  max_batch_size: 8
  max_wait_ms: 30
  prefetch: false
```
will push in 60s to canary subset.

support-alex: I told customer we’re investigating and will apply mitigations. CC: product-maya for customer comms. they asked for ETA ~30m.

product-maya: got it. please add summary + customer-facing explanation once stable. they’re on a paid Dedicated contract but using Hosted fallback atm. want to avoid SLA hit.

obs-jen: after canary push we should bump trace sampling to 20% for 10m to catch root traces. also created temporary log alert: count(handler_error) > 10/min -> page.

oncall-bot: config-change rollout started at 2398765425 to pool-usw2-03 canary (10% capacity).

sre-lucy: monitoring: queue_depth dropped to ~12 after canary, handler_error rate down 70% over 5m, p99 latency improving. keeping watch for 15m.

eng-raj: if numbers hold we'll propagate to remaining instances at +5m. rollbacks ready if errors increase.

support-alex: customer updated: saw fewer 504s after 5m and is able to proceed. still some retries but they're happy with progress. closing interim escalation if stable.

sre-lucy: postmortem notes to collect: deploy 2026-03-15_2315 enabled batcher-v2 + prefetch by default; didn't simulate short-request workloads; trace sampling dropped due to global sampling flag; recommend: (1) add canary traffic profile that includes short-chat workload, (2) avoid enabling prefetch by default for hosted pools, (3) add runtime metric alert on queue_depth per-GPU > 20 for 3m, (4) automated temporary increase in trace sampling on SLO breach.

product-maya: thanks — will coordinate comms and ensure CS credit review.

sre-lucy: assigning follow-ups: obs-jen (dash + alert), eng-raj (batcher default change + canary profile), support-alex (customer comms). tagging for postmortem: @eng-raj @obs-jen @support-alex. closing thread after 1h stable. :white_check_mark:
